name: Siddharth V K
text: I have worked along with Aman while volunteering in the Formula Bharat event that takes place annually. Formula Bharat is a great platform that encourages future builders and it has been great to see Aman consistently give time and mindshare for the cause. It is one thing to perform well in your professional duties, but I have a lot of respect for someone who takes time out voluntarily to give back to the ecosystem. Aman's enthusiasm and consistency will take him a long way in whatever challenge he takes up!

name: Vivek Patel
text: I had the opportunity to work with Aman in the Crash team at Daimler Truck. He joined as a fresher but quickly stood out with his strong technical skills and eagerness to learn. Aman consistently took initiative in technical discussions and was proactive in driving solutions forward.  His ability to grasp complex concepts, coupled with his willingness to contribute beyond his immediate responsibilities, made him a valuable team member. Aman’s enthusiasm and dedication to continuous improvement set a great example for others in the team.  I am confident that he will continue to excel and make significant contributions in any role he takes on.

name: Rahul Maity
text: I had the opportunity to closely connect with Aman while volunteering at the Indian Formula Student event. His passion for automotive and motorsports is evident, along with his strong leadership skills and eagerness to share knowledge. His constant zeal to learn and grow makes him a great person to work with. I highly recommend Aman for his dedication, enthusiasm, and leadership.

name: Subrata Kumar Mondal
company: Suzuki R&D Center India Private Limited
text: I had the pleasure of working closely with Aman and being his buddy during our time together at DTICI. He is an agile and adaptable person who is always open to suggestions and willing to learn. I particularly appreciated his ability to understand instructions clearly, take feedback positively, and apply it effectively in his work.  One of his notable strengths is his strong interest and knowledge of the automobile industry. His familiarity with different automobile brands, combined with his association with racing tracks and cars, gives him a broader practical perspective and genuine passion for the automotive domain.  He is also a good team player who is easy to work with and brings a positive attitude to the team.   I wish Aman all the very best for his studies and future career. I am confident that he will make the most of this opportunity and continue to explore his interests in the automotive field.

name: Ujjwal Trakroo
text: I worked with Aman on our Formula Student (FS) car and later at Formula Bharat, where he joined us as a Scrutineer. On the FS car he worked powertrain and vehicle dynamics together, which is normally a two-person split. It's a heavy workload, and he carried it to the end. He's thorough and pushes hard on the weak spots in engineering design scrutiny, and is always around to help the teams. Solid with first principles, and brings great, consistent energy to the operation!

name: Bijoy Pradhan
text: Aman always keep himself acquainted with the latest automotive technologies. Technical dscussions with him always reflect his deep mathematical foundations. Excellent skills on automation and logic building. All this perfectly aligns towards his immense passion towards F1 cars. I recommend and wish him luck in this direction.

name: Arunsankar Punnaiappan
text: Aman is enthusiastic to learn new technologies  Very quick in grasping and go deep in the topics.  Volunteering to take up and team related responsibilities.  Structured thoughts & clear communication is his key strengths.  Am sure that Aman will reach great heights..
